content: coffee A controlled blast on a film set close to the O2 arena ignited a fire that wrecked a van and harmed a car and a lorry, prompting London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday. About twenty‑five firefighters brought the blaze under control in a little over an hour, with no injuries reported. The incident is said to have stemmed from a pre‑planned filming activity near the venue, which will host shows by Niall Horan and Texas the following week. The brigade posted on X that the fire is now contained, noting the loss of one van and substantial damage to a car and a lorry, and confirming no casualties. They added that the fire originated from a controlled explosion on the set that escaped containment, and crews will stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near London’s cable‑car crossing over the Thames, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
